summary.text: Matthew Martinez, a Democrat, represents District 62 in the Colorado House of Representatives, covering Alamosa, Conejos, Costilla, Huerfano, Mineral, Pueblo, Rio Grande and Saguache counties.

paragraphs.text: He has held the seat since January 2023, succeeding Donald Valdez, and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.

He was born in Monte Vista, Colorado, served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2005 to 2009, and earned a bachelor's degree from Adams State University in 2013 and a master's degree from Southern New Hampshire University in 2020.
His career experience includes directing the correspondence education program at Adams State University and teaching veterans and inmates.
